declared_by: Qoder agent, on the user's instruction of 2026-11-02
purpose: Collect descriptive evidence on whether dmd_adapted_mobilenet_v3_20261029 could serve as the system's active vision model. This protocol, its runs and its evidence do not change the active model; the user decides afterwards.
prohibited_inferences: No model is declared the winner by this protocol; no test-set result selects a threshold, a fusion weight or a model.
No accuracy, FPR, latency or agreement number here is evidence of real-world risk-prediction accuracy, safety benefit or accident reduction.
DMD body-view frames and State Farm images are different cameras and datasets; a DMD-test result does not predict frontal-camera behaviour.
Agreement between two models on constructed inputs is not evidence that either is correct.
The archived 0.7038 threshold is not used by the runtime and is reported only as a historical column.

stable.selection: no DRA_ACTIVE_VISION variable (the stable provider path)

comparison_objects.same_inputs_rule: Within each dataset comparison, both models receive exactly the same image files in the same order; no image is re-encoded, resized or regenerated by the comparison script.
comparison_objects.same_code_rule: Within each dataset comparison, both models run through the same inference function and the same metric code. State Farm uses the runtime provider path for both models; the DMD test set uses scripts/dmd_infer_test.py for both ONNX files.

state_farm_test.role: source domain; check whether DMD fine-tuning degraded the original State Farm behaviour
state_farm_test.provenance: the frozen 3657-record input list of run p4b_20261022 (ml/outputs/runs/p4b_20261022, bank_manifest metadata vision_sources.json, sha256 098001f1816dd2aea40d5efcdd50ee349e1b1b7af6f20abf9dc6bbfb15bb08bb); never re-split
state_farm_test.inference_path: one child process per model: base64 of the original JPEG bytes -> backend TrainedProvider.preprocess -> the loaded model's ONNX session -> one float32-softmax converted to float64; the loaded model_id is checked before any image is forwarded
metrics: per-class precision, recall, F1 and support (10 classes)
log loss from the model's own 10-class probabilities

binary diagnostic at threshold 0.5: safe (true c0) versus the other nine classes; report c0_false_positive_proxy = fraction of true c0 frames with P_distraction >= 0.5, distraction_recall = fraction of true non-c0 frames with P_distraction >= 0.5, binary accuracy
state_farm_test.archive_cross_check: The recomputed stable metrics are compared with run p4b_20261022's MN-STABLE clean metrics (accuracy 0.8988241728192508, macro-F1 0.8746408408872671, log loss 0.5744531434764406). A mismatch beyond 1e-9 is reported as a failed cross-check, not silently ignored.

dmd_body_test.role: adapted domain; descriptive behaviour on the two held-out DMD test subjects
dmd_body_test.inference_path: scripts/dmd_infer_test.py for BOTH ONNX files: PIL RGB resize 224 bilinear, /255, ImageNet mean/std, NCHW float32 -> ONNX logits -> one softmax -> P_distraction = 1 - P(c0)
metrics: per-class precision, recall, F1 and support (10 classes)
log loss from the model's own 10-class probabilities
binary metrics at 0.5 and at the archived 0.7037721940337633 threshold: recall, FPR, precision, balanced accuracy, rocAUC, prAUC, Brier, ECE
dmd_body_test.operative_threshold_reason: The live runtime consumes the continuous P_distraction = 1 - P(c0); no 0.7038 threshold exists in the fusion or risk path. The 0.5 column is the runtime-equivalent binary diagnostic.
dmd_body_test.non_operative_threshold_note: Selected on the gB_10 validation subject in the 2026-10-29 DMD run and archived in docs/evidence/2026-10-29/dmd-adaptation/selected_threshold.json. Reported only as a historical column; it is not applied at runtime.
dmd_body_test.archive_cross_check: The recomputed stable zero-shot metrics are compared with docs/evidence/2026-10-29/dmd-adaptation/zero_shot_unexposed.json and the recomputed candidate metrics with comparison_test.json; a material mismatch is reported as a failed cross-check.

checks: provider.info.vision.classes equals the runtime label list with c0 = safe_driving

provider_vs_direct_onnx.sample: from the frozen State Farm test list, sort by class then filename and take the first 20 images of each of the 10 classes (200 images)
provider_vs_direct_onnx.method: one child process: provider.preprocess(original JPEG bytes) -> tensor; the provider's ONNX session and a second independently loaded ONNX session on the same candidate file both forward the same tensor; both probability vectors come from one float32 softmax converted to float64
provider_vs_direct_onnx.pass_rule: max_abs_prob_delta <= 1e-4 AND argmax_agreement == 1.0, exactly the FUD-01 conditions of docs/fyp2/task10a/tolerance_predeclaration.md (APPROVED 2026-10-26); the tolerance is never relaxed after seeing a result
provider_vs_direct_onnx.additional_information: provider.preprocess tensor vs scripts/dmd_infer_test.preprocess tensor: max_abs_tensor_delta and argmax agreement are recorded for information; this is not part of the pass rule

c_threshold_semantics.runtime_formula: P_distraction = 1 - P(safe_driving) is fused directly; no threshold is applied between the visual model and the fusion.
c_threshold_semantics.fact: The 0.7037721940337633 value was selected on the gB_10 validation subject and is not used by the runtime. The runtime-equivalent diagnostic is the 0.5 column. On the 2026-10-29 DMD test results, the adapted model has FPR 0.2074 at 0.5 and FPR 0.0891 at 0.7038; the former describes what the feature consumes, the latter describes a threshold that is not in the product.

d_performance.load: one throw-away uvicorn on a free port with a temporary SQLite, Chromium fake camera, the app's 10 requests/s loop with one request in flight, 600 measured windows after 20 warm-up windows
metrics: Server-Timing vision p50/p95 (the server-side visual model time)
achieved rate (Hz), short_run flag, console errors, attempts_other_than_1
d_performance.archive: each run keeps perf01.json and perf01_timings.json; the raw timings file's sha256 must equal perf01.json's raw_timings.sha256 and the quantiles are recomputed from it
d_performance.scope_statement: one development machine (Apple M2), Chromium fake camera, frozen models; not target hardware, not a real camera

e_system_level.rule: E2/E5 may be run on the DMD candidate only after A-D are complete. It requires a NEW protocol file committed before that run (docs/fyp2/e2e5/protocol.json is the already-committed stable declaration and must not be edited), plus a fusion_eval.py entry point that lets the new protocol name the vision model, with tests. The stable E2/E5 evidence of 2026-11-02 is kept as is and is not rerun or overwritten.

f_camera_check.reason: Requires the user physically to perform the actions in front of the camera.

phases.instruction: hold and look at a phone, 60 s
drink from a cup or bottle, 60 s

metrics: normal: fraction of windows whose top-1 class is safe_driving
phone and drinking: top-1 class counts, P_distraction mean/median, fraction of windows with P_distraction >= 0.5
all phases: per-frame top-1 and the ten probabilities are saved raw
f_camera_check.not_a_claim: A single 60 s clip per action cannot establish real-world accuracy or a safety benefit.

subdirectories.a-source-domain: State Farm test and DMD test results, raw predictions, per-class CSVs, README
subdirectories.b-runtime-compat: manifest validation output, provider identity, provider-vs-direct parity, README
subdirectories.d-perf: six perf01 runs with raw timings, runs log, README
subdirectories.e-system-level: only if the optional E protocol is committed and run
subdirectories.f-camera-check: script, checklist, empty results template; the user fills it

artifacts.candidate_package_rule: The candidate package's evaluation_metrics.json is {} and MUST NOT be edited in place. Any extra metrics belong under the evidence directory with the reason recorded.
artifacts.decision_facts: docs/fyp2/dmd-candidate/decision_facts.md lists facts and numbers only, without choosing a model.
